name: Team conversations
description:
**Summary**

- Goal: replace the mock "Quick messages" thread in the solopreneur **Messages** section with the real **Teams conversations**, reusing existing components.
- Investigated `SolopreneurMessages.vue`, `SolopreneurView.vue`, `TeamChannelsSidebar.vue`, `TeamChannel.vue`, `TeamDM.vue`, `store/teams.js`, and `solopreneur/i18n.js`.
- `TeamChannelsSidebar.vue` was extended, backward-compatibly, with `inPlace`, `activeChannelId`, `activeMemberId` props and `open-channel` / `open-dm` emits (plus selection highlighting).
- `SolopreneurMessages.vue` was rewritten as a rail + pane layout: sidebar for teams/categories/channels/DMs, `TeamChannel` / `TeamDM` for the conversation, syncing selection into the teams store.
- `i18n.js` gained a new `mc.*` key group (EN/ES/FR); remaining note: `hasConversation` is unused and `state.messages`/`sendMessage` are now dead code.

messages.content: The Messages section in solopreneur will open the Teams conversations. Use the existing components

I'll locate the existing Teams/conversations components before proposing changes.## 1. Review & Understand the Task

- The **Messages** module of the solopreneur view (`/solopreneur/messages`) must stop rendering the mock "Quick messages" thread and instead **show the real Teams conversations** (channels + direct messages).
- "Use the existing components" → reuse `TeamChannelsSidebar.vue`, `TeamChannel.vue`, `TeamDM.vue` (the latter two already wrap `Chat.vue`).
- Key constraint discovered: `TeamChannelsSidebar` currently calls `$storex.ui.openTeamChannel()` / `openTeamDM()`, which open **new dockview panels** — wrong inside the solopreneur screen, where the conversation must open *in place*.
- Second gap: the sidebar has no selected-item state, which a two‑pane Messages screen needs.

## 2. Information Gathered

| Source | Finding |
|---|---|
| `src/components/solopreneur/SolopreneurMessages.vue` | Mock AI thread (`state.messages`, `sendMessage`) — to be replaced |
| `src/views/SolopreneurView.vue` | Renders `SolopreneurMessages` in `<main>`, `state.viewport.isWide/isXl` measured from real width |
| `src/components/teams/TeamChannelsSidebar.vue` | Reusable list (team selector, categories, channels, DMs, AI profiles); opens panels via store |
| `src/components/teams/TeamChannel.vue` | Props `params: { team, channel }`; loads chat by `channel.chatId`; renders `<Chat>` |
| `src/components/teams/TeamDM.vue` | Props `params: { team, member, chatId }`; renders `<Chat>` |
| `src/store/teams.js` | `selectChannel`, `openDirectMessage` (returns/creates `chatId`), `selectTeam`, `createTeam`, `loadTeams`, `activeTeam` getter |
| `src/components/solopreneur/i18n.js` | All solopreneur copy lives here (`ms.*` group) |
| `src/components/solopreneur/useSolopreneur.js` | `state.viewport`, `t()`, no changes needed |

## 3. Change Proposal

- **`TeamChannelsSidebar.vue`** — add opt‑in, backward‑compatible behaviour:
  - props `inPlace`, `activeChannelId`, `activeMemberId`;
  - emits `open-channel`, `open-dm`;
  - `openChannel()` / `openDm()` emit instead of calling `$storex.ui.*` when `inPlace`;
  - highlight the selected channel/DM. Defaults keep the desktop Teams behaviour untouched.
- **`SolopreneurMessages.vue`** — rewrite as a two‑pane "conversations" section:
  - header (title, description, online dot, "Open Teams" for desktop hosts);
  - empty state (no teams → create team);
  - rail = `TeamChannelsSidebar` (`in-place`);
  - pane = `TeamChannel` / `TeamDM` keyed by selection, fixed height so `Chat.vue` scrolls internally;
  - selection persisted into the teams store (`selectChannel`, `openDirectMessage`, `selectTeam`).
- **`i18n.js`** — add `mc.*` keys (EN/ES/FR) for the new copy.
- `useSolopreneur.js` untouched (`state.messages`/`sendMessage` become unused only by this section — safe).

## 4. Changes Summary

| File | Type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `src/components/teams/TeamChannelsSidebar.vue` | update | `inPlace` mode + selection highlighting; default behaviour preserved |
| `src/components/solopreneur/SolopreneurMessages.vue` | update | Section now hosts the real Teams conversations |
| `src/components/solopreneur/i18n.js` | update | New `mc.*` copy in EN/ES/FR |

## 5. The Changes

      default: () => []
    },
    // Embedded hosts (e.g. the solopreneur Messages section) open the
    // conversation inside their own pane instead of a new dockview panel:
    // with `inPlace` the clicks are EMITTED and no panel is opened.
    inPlace: {
      type: Boolean,
      default: false
    },
    // Selection highlight — only used when `inPlace` is set.
    activeChannelId: {
      type: String,
      default: null
    },
    activeMemberId: {
      type: String,
      default: null
    }
  },
  emits: [
    'select-team',
    'create-team',
    'open-team-settings',
    'open-create-channel',
    'edit-category',
    'edit-channel',
    'add-member',
    'select-member',
    'open-channel',
    'open-dm'
  ],
  data() {
    return {
      channelSearch: '',
      dmCollapsed: false,
      profilesCollapsed: false
    }
  },
  computed: {
    filteredCategories() {
      if (!this.activeTeam) return []
      const cats = this.activeTeam.categories || []
      if (!this.channelSearch) return cats
      const q = this.channelSearch.toLowerCase()
      return cats.map(cat => ({
        ...cat,
        channels: cat.channels.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      })).filter(cat => cat.channels.length)
    }

  methods: {

      return !!this.inPlace && !!channel && channel.id === this.activeChannelId

    openDm(member) {
      if (this.inPlace) {
        this.$emit('open-dm', member)
        return

      this.$storex.ui.openTeamDM({ team: this.activeTeam, member })
    },
    removeProfile(profile) {

    }
  }
}

<script setup>
import { computed, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { $storex } from '@/store'
import { useSolopreneur } from './useSolopreneur'
import TeamChannelsSidebar from '@/components/teams/TeamChannelsSidebar.vue'
import TeamChannel from '@/components/teams/TeamChannel.vue'
import TeamDM from '@/components/teams/TeamDM.vue'

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Messages section — the REAL Teams conversations.
//
// It reuses the existing Teams building blocks instead of the mock thread:
//
//   • TeamChannelsSidebar → conversation rail (teams, categories, channels, DMs)
//   • TeamChannel / TeamDM → conversation pane (both wrap Chat.vue)
//
// Teams opens every conversation in its own dockview panel; here they all share
// ONE pane, so the selection lives in this component (`inPlace` on the sidebar
// makes it emit instead of opening panels) and is mirrored into the teams store
// so the rest of the app keeps the same "active" conversation.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const { state, t } = useSolopreneur()

const teams = computed(() => $storex.teams.teams || [])
const activeTeam = computed(() => $storex.teams.activeTeam)

// Conversation open in the pane: { kind: 'channel' | 'dm', id }
const selected = ref(null)
const dmChatId = ref(null)
const dmLoading = ref(false)

// Width tier measured by the view (route host or dockview panel).
const isWide = computed(() => state.viewport.isWide)
// The Teams app only exists as a dockview panel (desktop host).
const canOpenTeamsApp = computed(() => !!$storex.ui?.isDesktopMode)

const activeChannel = computed(() => {
  const team = activeTeam.value
  if (!team || selected.value?.kind !== 'channel') return null
  for (const category of team.categories || []) {
    const channel = (category.channels || []).find(c => c.id === selected.value.id)
    if (channel) return channel
  }
  return null
})

const activeMember = computed(() => {
  const team = activeTeam.value
  if (!team || selected.value?.kind !== 'dm') return null
  return (team.members || []).find(m => m.id === selected.value.id) || null
})

// TeamChannel needs `channel.chatId`; a DM chat is created on demand.
const hasConversation = computed(() => {
  if (activeChannel.value) return !!activeChannel.value.chatId
  if (activeMember.value) return !!dmChatId.value
  return false
})

// ── Selection ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function selectChannel(channel) {
  const team = activeTeam.value
  if (!team || !channel) return
  dmChatId.value = null
  selected.value = { kind: 'channel', id: channel.id }
  $storex.teams.selectChannel({ teamId: team.id, channelId: channel.id })
}

async function selectMember(member) {
  const team = activeTeam.value
  if (!team || !member) return
  selected.value = { kind: 'dm', id: member.id }
  dmChatId.value = null
  dmLoading.value = true
  try {
    // Returns the existing DM chat or creates it (same call Teams uses).
    dmChatId.value = await $storex.teams.openDirectMessage({ teamId: team.id, member })
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[Solopreneur] could not open the direct message', e)
    $storex.ui.addNotification({ text: t('mc.dmError'), type: 'error' })
  } finally {
    dmLoading.value = false
  }
}

// Restore what Teams had open (DM, then channel), else the first channel.
function selectDefaultConversation() {
  const team = activeTeam.value
  dmChatId.value = null
  if (!team) {
    selected.value = null
    return
  }

  const channels = (team.categories || []).flatMap(c => c.channels || [])
  const member = (team.members || []).find(m => m.id === $storex.teams.activeDmMemberId)
  const channel = channels.find(c => c.id === $storex.teams.activeChannelId) || channels[0]

  if (member) {
    selectMember(member)
    return
  }
  selected.value = channel ? { kind: 'channel', id: channel.id } : null
}

function selectTeam(team) {
  if (!team) return
  $storex.teams.selectTeam(team.id)
  selectDefaultConversation()
}

async function createTeam() {
  try {
    await $storex.teams.createTeam({ name: t('mc.newTeamName') })
    selectDefaultConversation()
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[Solopreneur] could not create the team', e)
    $storex.ui.addNotification({ text: t('mc.teamError'), type: 'error' })
  }
}

function openTeamsApp() {
  $storex.ui.openTeams()
}

// Switching team resets the pane to that team's default conversation.
watch(() => activeTeam.value?.id, selectDefaultConversation)
// The first member received after mount may be the DM that Teams had open.
watch(() => activeTeam.value?.members?.length, () => {
  if (!selected.value) selectDefaultConversation()
  else if (selected.value.kind === 'dm' && !dmChatId.value && !dmLoading.value) {
    const member = activeMember.value
    if (member) selectMember(member)
  }
})

onMounted(async () => {
  // Teams may not be loaded yet (cold start on a deep link): best effort.
  if (!teams.value.length && $storex.projects?.activeProject) {
    await $storex.teams.loadTeams()
  }
  selectDefaultConversation()
})
